text: Vehicles moving along a runway or taxiway shall give way at all times to aircraft taking off, landing, taxiing, or being towed, except that emergency services vehicles proceeding to the assistance of an aircraft in distress shall be afforded priority over all other surface movement traffic. Question. When will vehicles have priority over all other surface movement traffic?
